propositions: The baseline_advanced_at stamp is written in one place but read nowhere in src/, so deleting it removes scattered edits that defeat git delta compression.
set_baseline should compare the filtered baseline to the existing one and return early when equal, avoiding rewriting an unchanged baseline.
The guard must preserve `if k in fields` semantics so a baseline key stays present with a None value rather than being dropped, keeping local-wins diff behavior correct.
Two consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must produce byte-identical bindings.json and create no commit.
A positive control must confirm that changing a stored baseline value from A to B still persists B and changes the saved bytes, so the guard never degenerates into never-write.
All three set_baseline callers (_advance_baselines, inbound-adopt path, seed_baselines_from_snapshot) are covered for no-op-on-unchanged and persist-on-changed behavior.
